title: Non-exhaustive enums on all public types is correctly applied
description: All public enums (SmimeError, CertChainError, RecipientIdentifier, KeyEncryptionAlgorithm, KeyWrapAlgorithm, KariKeyAgreement, DigestAlgorithm, EcCurve, TransferEncoding) have #[non_exhaustive]. This is the correct choice for a library that hasn't reached 1.0: future algorithm additions can be made without breaking callers. The DecryptionKey docs correctly document that matches_recipient() implementations must include _ => false. Well done.
